info.name: Linux Security Audit API - Updated
info.description: Updated for current internal/api router and service DTOs. Run Admin Login first; set credentials locally. Create policy before assigning policy_id to a host. Host policy_id is optional on POST and supports integer/null on PATCH. Rule JSON field is type (not rule_type). Snapshot import needs real collector v2 JSON. Destructive requests run last. Tokens are not embedded.

request.description: Create host without a policy. Optional policy_id may be supplied as a positive integer if an existing policy is known. Response id is saved to {{host_id}}.
Host validation rejects empty name/hostname; expect 400.
PATCH accepts partial fields: name, hostname, description, os, kernel, architecture, policy_id. Omitted fields remain unchanged.
Assign existing policy to existing host. Run Create Policy and Create Host first. The variable is inserted as a JSON number.
Clear policy assignment. Omitted policy_id would leave it unchanged.

Rule DTO expects type, severity, enabled (optional; defaults true), parameters (optional; defaults {}). Allowed severity: LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL. Duplicate rule type for one policy may be rejected.
INFO is not accepted by the current rule validator; expect 400.
